name: Johann Birkenmeier
searchedNoResult: Munzingen 1869 death register (Johann Birkenmaier, single mason, as witness: a different, younger man)
researchLogEntry: Round 4: brief pass. A Johann Birkenmaier, single mason, witnessed Karolina Birkenmaier's death in Munzingen in 1869. That man is a younger namesake, not this Basel mason born 1808, but it shows the Birkenmaier mason clan was still active in Munzingen.
